_note: PLACEHOLDER rules for the skill system (not in your skill files). points_per_level: skill points earned each level. Every rank of a skill costs that skill's skill_point_cost. The class's first (level 1) skill is learned for free at rank 1. ability_rank_cost: points for each rank above 1 of an ultimate or special attack. require_trials: when true, ultimates and specials also need the trial to be completed (the trials come with quests).
